text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Tuesday, January 29, 2019 Posted by admin on January 29th, 2019
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +68 points.
Monday the Dow was down -208.98 (-0.84%) at 24,528.22.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +5.15%.
There were 6 Dow stocks up Monday.
The Dow stock winners Monday were led by DowDuPont (DWDP) +0.64%, Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) +0.59% and JPMorgan (JPM) +0.47%.
The Dow stock losers Monday were led by Caterpillar (CAT) -9.13%, Pfizer (PFE) -2.73% and Verizon (VZ) -2.36%.
See 3M (MMM), Pfizer (PFE) and Verizon (VZ) earnings below. Apple (AAPL) reports earnings after the close today.
The FOMC Meeting begins today with announcement tomorrow at 11:00 am PST.
European stocks are higher and Asian markets ended mostly lower.
The national average price of gasoline is down three-tenths of a cent at $2.258 per gallon.
